name: carry_box
title: Carry a box (walk while holding a payload at chest height)
summary: A cyclic BATON specialist: the G1 walks while holding its arms in a constant carry pose (hands chest-high 0.28 m apart, elbows bent) tracking a carry ghost, trained with a 1.5 kg payload folded into the plant. Same 120-dim cyclic obs family as walk, so BATON blends walk<->carry element-wise. Carries the real ODE box along its natural arc in the delivery demo.

ghost.notes: FK-designed BEFORE training: authentic v3 legs + sway, constant carry arms (hands x+0.195 z+0.134, box-width 0.280 m).

baton.notes: Enter COLD (BATON_COLD_HIDDEN): a warm handover after a stand locks the carrier's hidden into the stand attractor (it marches in place). Course keyword: carryto.

train.notes: carrier2 retrained with W_TRACK_LIN=10 (walks 12.9 m live solo) + 1.5 kg payload. Payload folded into plant by structural hand-link resolution (leaf of elbow chain). VERIFY frozen bundle before re-training; see memory project_baton_policy_switching Round 7.

specialist.note: Emitted as a BATON_SPECIALISTS entry (mode|checkpoint|ghost_lut|vx) by the sequencer; not a standalone primary.

verification.result: Carries the real 1.5 kg box 5 m along its arc, 0 falls, in the box-delivery sequence (7/7 switches, worst transient 2.1 deg).
